title: Secured B2 data flow
purpose: Show the authenticated, role-validated, server-side signed path to Backblaze B2 object operations, including rejection paths, based on Phase 1A implementation.
accessible_text: An authenticated user presents a Supabase session. The server verifies the session, validates role and object-prefix, performs a server-side signed B2 operation, and verifies completion/metadata. Unverified sessions, invalid roles, and invalid prefixes are rejected before any B2 call. No credentials or secret names are shown.
